name: coordinator-buffer-derived-only
body: The coordinator buffers only the derived projection. Durable node files and their per-logical-mutation commits are written as they are today (directly, one commit per mutation) unless a deliberate write-ahead-log design is chosen; only the derived DB flush is deferred/batched. Durable writes are never buffered in memory without a WAL. Acceptance: killing the session between mutations loses no durable write; only a rebuildable DB flush is outstanding, and one logical mutation → one commit still holds.
